name: Velhorn Loader
text: Age III. Keeps its own chunk loaded while it burns fuel, about 13 minutes per coal. Feed it by hand; use it empty-handed to read time left. Owner and team only.

name: Marduvain Loader
text: Age V. Keeps a 3x3 square of chunks loaded. Burns fuel twice as fast as the Velhorn. Made from a Velhorn Loader, iron blocks and ender pearls.

name: Ixthuran Loader
text: Age VII. Keeps a 5x5 square of chunks loaded. Burns fuel four times as fast as the Velhorn. Made from a Marduvain Loader, diamonds and eyes of ender.

name: Rhovel Cartseal
text: Age V. Use on a minecart to keep the 3x3 chunks around it loaded while it rides, 30 minutes per seal, up to 3 hours.

name: Loader Limits
text: Each player may own 4 loaders and 2 sealed carts by default. The server may change these. Only the owner, their team or an operator may fuel or break a loader.

name: Loader List
text: The command /diaithirchunkloaders list shows your loaders, where they are, their radius and time left.
